message:
You can restrict which UK countries users can select on the map.

For example, you can allow locations in England only, while excluding Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland.

You can choose what type of location users can draw on the map:

- a pin (single point)
- a shape (area)
- a line

You can allow one type or any combination of these.

We are aware of an issue affecting some form submissions with file uploads. We're currently investigating the cause for this, although we believe this to be limited to a subset of forms.

If your users have any issues submitting their form and they want to keep their progress, they can use the "Save and exit" feature come back to the submission at a later date.

This issue is now resolved in production.

What was the issue?
A subset of users who uploaded files were unable to submit their forms. We traced this to an issue where users had bulk-uploaded multiple files for a given question.

What did we do?
We released an update to prevent new users from experiencing issues uploading files. The final fix was then deployed, allowing affected users returning via "Save and exit" to successfully submit their in-progress forms.

What do users need to know?
- Form recovery: users can load their forms and attempt to submit again.
- Re-uploading files: if a user used multiple upload, they may need to re-upload those specific files.
- Guided process: the form will flag affected files and prompt a re-upload.

This affected a subset of users, so you likely only need to contact customers who opened a support query.
